# Manila Pampanga Go Taxi

> Private car with driver (not self-drive) serving Pampanga, Metro Manila and destinations across Luzon, Philippines.

- Services: airport transfers (NAIA, Clark), Pampanga to Metro Manila, out-of-town trips, whole-day service.
- Fixed fares: Pampanga to Metro Manila. Other routes: request a quotation.
- Contact: WhatsApp and Viber +639345986176, KakaoTalk 09853900002, email manilapampangagotaxi@gmail.com
- Languages on the website: English, Chinese, Korean
